---
title: "Database Demo"
---

## Install ODBC Drivers
```
setup odbc on macOS
install homebrew -> follow instruction to add homebrew to PATH
brew install unixodbc
brew install psqlodbc
```

## Local DB + Generic ODBC Package
```{r}
library(DBI)
library(odbc)

con <- dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  Driver   = "/opt/homebrew/lib/psqlodbcw.so",
  Server   = "localhost",
  Port     = 5432,
  Database = "postgres",
  UID      = Sys.info()["user"],
  PWD      = ""
)

dbWriteTable(con, )

dbExecute(con, "CREATE TEMP TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50));")
dbExecute(con, "INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Alice'), ('Bob');")

result <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10")
print(result)

dbDisconnect(con)
```


## Local DB + RPostgres R Package
```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)

con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  dbname   = "postgres",
  host     = "localhost",
  port     = 5432,
  user     = as.character(Sys.info()["user"]),
  password = ""
)

dbExecute(con, "CREATE TEMP TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50));")
dbExecute(con, "INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Alice'), ('Bob');")

result <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10")
print(result)

dbDisconnect(con)
```


## Remote DB + Generic ODBC Package
```{r}
library(DBI)
library(odbc)

pwd <- readLines("../../hashcx/api-keys/neon.tech-ds212.pwd")

con <- dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  Driver   = "/opt/homebrew/lib/psqlodbcw.so",
  Server   = "ep-patient-cell-bd0cj75h-pooler.c-8.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech", # Remote host
  Port     = 5432,
  Database = "neondb",
  UID      = "neondb_owner",
  PWD      = pwd,
  SSLMode  = "require"
)

dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(50),
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  );
")

dbExecute(con, "
  INSERT INTO users (name) 
  VALUES ('Alice'), ('Bob');
")

result <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10")
print(result)

dbDisconnect(con)
```
